oracle.oracle_text: The first spell you cast from exile each turn has cascade.
oracle.rulings: 2021-07-23: First exile-cast gets cascade even if not first spell of turn; casting before Wild-Magic Sorcerer enters precludes granting to later exile-cast spells; a spell's cascade triggers upon casting and survives countering that spell; multiple instances cascade independently.

fixture.real_list: 100 physical cards (1 commander + 99 zones), 94 distinct names; 34 baseline lands
fixture.source_paid: Call Forth the Tempest {5}{R}{R}{R} cast from hand using 3 real Mountains, 3 real Islands, 2 real Swamps, after conditional earlier source-triggered 9 total opponent life loss from Loyal Subordinate; X0 variants explicitly tested.
fixture.fixed_library_top: Physically place Arcane Signet MV2, Sol Ring MV1, Talisman of Creativity MV2, Lotus Petal MV0 on top in that order for X9 nested trace; exiled cards from each cascade are physically tracked; virtual copies and tokens are not 99-card sources.
fixture.timing: Call's printed two cascades + conditional Abaddon-granted third are pending independent on-cast triggers. First cast from exile with Sorcerer on battlefield receives cascade; its nested cascade triggers and resolves above the initial spell; subsequent exile-casts get no Sorcerer cascade. The original hand-cast Call never receives Sorcerer cascade.
fixture.zero_cascade: When first exile-cast has MV0, its new cascade has no eligible nonland (nonnegative MV); the entire remaining library is exiled then returned to bottom in a possible shuffled permutation, preserving every physical card and not assigning empirical probability.

registered_cases.expected: X9 hand Call has 3 outer cascade triggers; first actual exile-cast Arcane Signet MV2 gets Wild cascade, physically hit Sol Ring MV1; later Talisman MV2 and Lotus Petal MV0 are casts without extra Wild cascades. Four exiled spells actually cast, four Lost Spawns, Call sweeper total MV5.

X0 hand Call has only two printed cascades, first exile-cast Arcane Signet gets nested Sol Ring, second printed gets Talisman, no third Abaddon trigger. Three exile casts and 3 Lost Spawns, Call sweep MV5.

First exile-cast Lotus Petal MV0 legally gains cascade but nested ability has no eligible lower-MV nonland; physical full remaining library is moved to exile then bottomed in a legally possible permutation, not a fabricated second cast.
Wild-Magic Sorcerer itself first cast from exile with no sorcerer yet controlled, enters, then next actual exile-cast Arcane Signet DOES NOT gain cascade retroactively; two printed Call casts only.
Opponent removes Wild-Magic Sorcerer after first exile spell cast and its new cascade has triggered; pending nested cascade still resolves and later exile-casts do not gain Wild cascade.
Opponent counters original hand-cast Call after its on-cast triggers exist; independent printed/granted and nested cascade triggers resolve; Call does not sweep opposing creatures.

In separate subfixtures, Drannith or Rule of Law prevents all free exile casts from a source-paid Call; printed and granted cascade abilities still exile/bottom cards; none acquires or triggers a Wild cascade and Lost stays at zero.

Opponent counters first Arcane Signet exile-cast after its granted cascade has triggered but before nested resolves; nested Sol Ring still cast, later printed hits allowed, physical Arcane moves graveyard.

limitations: Source-paid topdeck order is conditional and not a measured likelihood.
The sorcerer is assumed previously on battlefield for the standard cases; its mana paid on a prior turn is not represented as a probability.
The first-exile-MV0 branch models all physical library exiled and bottomed; a deterministic possible permutation is not a stochastic win estimate.
Physical cards conserved, but the tracer is an intentionally narrow rules-state simulator, not comprehensive stack/priority simulation.
Do not certify M6 or revise 62 approved canonical decks.
